item.title: Preseterizer 0.5.0
item.description:
• Five new skins: 3D / Exploratory, Sculptural / Organic, Minimal / Instrument, Cinematic / Abstract, and Ethereal / Light.
  • Ethereal uses solid pearl panels with clearer controls and text, plus a restrained opalescent finish.
  • Existing skin choices and RGB waveform settings are preserved.
